title: Resume effect-class gate: require the task's effect class and admin for write-repo (T22)
done_when: make check and make suite-http-local pass, including conformance test T22 across HTTP, MCP and /work
constraints: Read AGENTS.md first; keep SPEC.md and architecture.json in sync with the gate
Never edit conformance/ or conformance.lock, and never weaken an existing test
Resuming a parked task requires a key holding the task's effect class, and an admin key when effect_class is write-repo
Enforce the same rule in access.py so HTTP (/v1/tasks/resume), MCP (resume) and /work share one gate
Writes are POST only; a GET on a write path answers 405 and changes nothing
No key, token or credential in any response, page, log or commit
Run make check before committing; one task per branch; do not push
notes: Add T22 to conformance-draft/SPEC.md (§7 and §10) and conformance-draft/test_service_surface.py proving a read-only key cannot resume a write-internal task and a non-admin key cannot resume a write-repo task.
